headlines.snippet: It was cleared for publication: Sergeant Ron Yonatan Reitman and Sergeant Yuval Shai Suileem fell in an attack at the Judea junction. Reitman, 23, from Ashkelon, and Suileem, 20, from Hod HaSharon, served in the Ari Battalion of the Rescue Brigade. Three additional fighters were moderately and lightly wounded. The IDF estimates that the terrorists planned a large attack against civilians, which was prevented thanks to the fighters' actions. The two terrorists were eliminated, and there is suspicion that a foreign photographer knew about the attack in advance. Netanyahu ordered an immediate lockdown of Hebron and full closure preparation in Judea and Samaria.
